Showing Up: Leadership & the Challenge of Chronic Absenteeism

Speaker: Dr. Judy Hubbell Date: April 16, 2026 Duration: 26:30

About this episode

Dr. Jill Handley discusses how to build systems of shared ownership that outlast any individual leader. We explore the transition from compliance-based management to a coaching culture.

  • Coaching vs. Compliance: A paradigm shift.
  • The master schedule as a strategic tool for equity.
  • Empowering teacher leaders to drive change.
